'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] damage [[critical infrastructure]] in [[Kyiv]] again, leaving parts of the capital without energy and water. Other energy facilities are damaged in [[Zaporizhzhia]], [[Kherson]], and [[Cherkasy]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2022/oct/31/russia-ukraine-war-live-news-russia-to-withdraw-some-units-from-kherson-region-ukraine-military-says (''The Guardian'')]
**A Russian [[cruise missile]] reportedly shot down by a Ukrainian anti-aircraft system crashes in the outskirts of [[Naslavcea]], [[Moldova]]. No casualties are reported, though some houses were damaged by the blast, according to the [[Government of Moldova|Moldovan government]]. [https://www.romaniajournal.ro/politics/missile-launched-by-the-russians-fell-on-the-republic-of-moldovas-territory/ (Romania Journal)]
**[[Norwegian prime minister|Norwegian Prime Minister]] [[Jonas Gahr Støre]] announces that [[Norway|the country]]'s military alert level will be increased tomorrow, in response to [[Unmanned combat aerial vehicle|military drone]] sightings near [[Oil platform|offshore oil rigs]] in the past few weeks. [https://www.euronews.com/2022/10/31/norway-raises-military-alert-level-after-suspicious-drone-sightings (Euronews)]
*The Iranian [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] seizes an [[oil tanker]] in international waters that was transporting fuel to the [[Persian Gulf]]. [https://www.tasnimnews.com/en/news/2022/10/31/2796555/irgc-seizes-tanker-smuggling-fuel-in-persian-gulf (Tasnim)]
*The [[List of prime ministers of Chad|Prime Minister]] of [[Chad]] [[Saleh Kebzabo]] confirms that government forces in North [[Tibesti Region|Tibesti]] have successfully found and subsequently freed hostage Jerome Hugonnot, a Franco-Australian conservationist, kidnapped in [[Wadi Fira]] three days prior. [https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20221031-kidnapped-franco-australian-conservationist-released-by-captors-in-chad (AFP via France 24)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Pacific typhoon season]]
**[[Tropical Storm Nalgae (2022)|Tropical Storm Nalgae]]
***The death toll from floods and [[landslide]]s caused by Tropical Storm Nalgae (Paeng) in the [[Philippines]], mostly in [[Bangsamoro]], increases to 98 with at least 64 others reported missing. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/oct/31/tropical-storm-nalgae-98-dead-in-one-of-most-destructive-storms-to-hit-philippines-this-year (''The Guardian'')]
*Two people are killed and another is injured by a helicopter crash in [[Verdal]], [[Trøndelag]], [[Norway]]. [https://apnews.com/article/europe-accidents-norway-helicopter-crashes-2ceb83910a8129a65ba882148fc1ba0b (AP)]
'''Law and crime'''
*[[Mahsa Amini protests]]
**[[Tehran]]'s chief prosecutor confirms that over 1,000 people have been charged by the authorities in connection to anti-[[government of the Islamic Republic of Iran|government]] protests in the capital. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-63456606 (BBC News)]
*[[Central African Republic Civil War]]
**A special court in the [[Central African Republic]] sentences three [[Return, Reclamation, Rehabilitation|3R]] [[militia]]men to 20 years to [[life in prison]] for [[crimes against humanity]]. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/2426704/c-africa-special-court-sentences-three-for-crimes-against-humanity (AFP via ''The Bangkok Post'')]
*Fifteen people are injured by a [[mass shooting|mass]] [[drive-by shooting]] in [[Chicago]], [[Illinois]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/shootings-chicago-f382ed265838b94f2c2f34848c0d66d5 (AP)] 
'''Sports'''
*[[British Cycling]] [[CEO]] Brian Facer [[resign]]s after a recent [[British Cycling#Criticism|series of controversial decisions]] made by the organization, including the announcement of a partnership with the oil and gas company [[Shell plc|Shell]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2022/oct/31/british-cycling-chief-brian-facer-steps-down-three-weeks-after-controversial-shell-deal (''The Guardian'')]
